|lore=Colonel Dyer’s aide. Coordinates '''scout''' actions. As a youth, raced swoops on homeworld of Corellia. Formerly served with Emperor’s Demonstration Team.
|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Adds one battle destiny with Colonel Dyer or if driving a swoop. May place Lieutenant Grond in Used Pile to cancel a Force drain at a related location.
|printings={{Card versions/Lieutenant Grond}}
